value.rationale: The studied binary word was the first published nonregular Abelian-complexity counterexample, so its typical power-scale complexity is independently motivated. An empirical law quantifies prevalence among its oscillating normalized values rather than only a topological limit interval; the explicit variance and certified negative third centered moment characterize nontrivial scale and asymmetry. The result is self-contained and reusable for probabilistic analysis at geometric factor lengths; it does not merely recompute finite tables or trivial parity.
